plan.scope: Synthetic horizontal positioning only; no hardware or genuine XYZ validation.
interpretation: Report every seed, estimator, attempted fix and failure; no seed selection after viewing results.
WLS and robust losses use identical frames within a case/seed; verify observation hashes.
Changing clock/geometry/noise changes datasets; cross-case comparisons are controlled synthetic scenarios, not identical observations.
NEES is e^T P^-1 e for stored full-rank XY covariance; nominal 95% ellipse coverage uses threshold 5.991. Diagnostics are finite-sample descriptions, not a calibration acceptance claim.
Accuracy is conditional on successful fixes; report availability separately. Runtime is environment-dependent and not expected to repeat exactly.
Non-coplanar geometry, vertical accuracy and MBWDE require separately validated scientific implementations and are excluded.

limitations: Synthetic horizontal model only. No hardware or vertical validation. No requirement or claim that a robust estimator always improves accuracy. Runtime and finite-sample coverage are descriptive.
